scientific_integrity: The sequence of edge-count integers and its asymptotics are already recorded in OEIS A371965 and Baril et al. (2024), for a different statistic. Only the graph interpretation, marked-vertex bijection, and sharp extremal degree are proposed as new.
scientific_limitations: Uses the published Type-A binary deletion intersection theorem
Does not determine an optimal code size or independence number
Historical equivalence in unindexed literature cannot be excluded
Finite verification is not a proof
No independent mathematical audit has been performed
title: Dyck-restricted two-read deletion graph: a vertex-marked bijection and sharp degree
